dataset_description: RuleLens 40-pair evaluation dataset for guarded semantic caching

pairs.source_question: Under Travel Policy v2, what is the maximum travel expense amount a reporting manager can approve on their own authority?
pairs.candidate_question: Under Travel Policy v2, what is the maximum travel expense amount a direct manager can approve on their own authority?
pairs.rationale: High-fidelity natural paraphrase of direct manager travel expense approval threshold under v2 (R-TRV-003, INR 50,000).

pairs.source_question: What is the standard daily meal subsistence allowance for employees on domestic travel assignments under Travel Policy v2?
pairs.candidate_question: Under Travel Policy v2, what daily meal subsistence allowance is provided for employees on domestic travel?
pairs.rationale: Natural paraphrase inquiring about the domestic meal per diem subsistence rate under v2 (INR 1,500, TRV-C01).

pairs.source_question: What is the maximum reimbursable nightly hotel rate for metropolitan cities starting July 1, 2026?
pairs.candidate_question: Starting July 1, 2026, what is the maximum nightly hotel reimbursement limit for metropolitan cities?
pairs.rationale: Paraphrase inquiring about the metropolitan hotel rate cap under Travel Policy v2 (INR 7,500, TRV-C03).

pairs.source_question: How many days in advance of departure must domestic flights be booked through the corporate travel portal?
pairs.candidate_question: How many days in advance of departure must domestic flights be reserved through the corporate travel portal?
pairs.rationale: Paraphrase for the 14-day flight advance booking notice requirement (R-TRV-005, TRV-B01).

pairs.source_question: Within how many days of incurring an expense must an employee submit a reimbursement claim?
pairs.candidate_question: Within what number of days from incurring an expense must an employee submit a reimbursement claim?
pairs.rationale: Paraphrase regarding the regular 30-day expense claim submission deadline (R-FIN-001, FIN-R01).

pairs.source_question: Within how many working days must supervising managers inspect and approve or return submitted expense claims?
pairs.candidate_question: Within how many business days must supervising managers review and approve or return submitted expense claims?
pairs.rationale: Paraphrase for the 5 working days supervising manager review timeline SLA (R-FIN-002, FIN-R02).

pairs.source_question: How many working days of paid annual vacation do full-time employees accrue per year under the leave policy?
pairs.candidate_question: How many working days of paid annual leave do full-time staff accrue per year under the leave policy?
pairs.rationale: Paraphrase for the 20 working days of annual paid vacation entitlement (R-PPO-001, PPO-B01).

pairs.source_question: During what specific daily hours must remote employees maintain active availability on company communication channels?
pairs.candidate_question: During what specific core hours each day must remote employees maintain availability on company communication channels?
pairs.rationale: Paraphrase for remote work core availability window from 10:00 to 16:00 (PPO-B03).

pairs.source_question: Under emergency procurement rules, what is the maximum spending cap that can proceed under Director emergency approval?
pairs.candidate_question: Under emergency procurement rules, what is the maximum spending limit that can proceed under Director emergency approval?
pairs.rationale: Paraphrase for Director emergency procurement cap of INR 300,000 without Board Committee review (R-PRC-004, PRC-E01).

pairs.source_question: What four data classification tiers does Asterline establish for company information assets?
pairs.candidate_question: What four data classification levels does Asterline define for company information assets?
pairs.rationale: Paraphrase for four institutional data classification tiers: Public, Internal, Confidential, Restricted (SEC-A01).

pairs.source_question: At what maximum interval must privileged and administrative user accounts undergo recertification review?
pairs.candidate_question: At what maximum frequency must privileged and administrative user accounts undergo recertification review?
pairs.rationale: Paraphrase for the 90-day privileged account recertification interval (R-SEC-003, SEC-I01).

pairs.source_question: Within what SLA must Priority 1 critical security incidents be contained according to policy?
pairs.candidate_question: Within what containment SLA must Priority 1 critical security incidents be addressed according to policy?
pairs.rationale: Paraphrase for 1-hour containment SLA for Priority 1 critical security incidents (R-SEC-004, SEC-I02).

pairs.source_question: Can a direct manager approve a travel expense of INR 50,000 under Travel Policy v2?
pairs.candidate_question: Can a direct manager approve a travel expense of INR 75,000 under Travel Policy v2?
pairs.rationale: Expense amount changed from INR 50,000 (standard manager approval) to INR 75,000 (exceeds limit; requires Director sign-off).

pairs.source_question: Do incidental expenses of INR 1,000 require an itemized tax receipt under corporate card policy?
pairs.candidate_question: Do incidental expenses of INR 2,500 require an itemized tax receipt under corporate card policy?
pairs.rationale: Receipt requirement threshold changed from INR 1,000 (exempt from itemized receipt) to INR 2,500 (mandatory itemized tax invoice).

pairs.source_question: Can an employee book a flight 14 days in advance under the travel booking procedure?
pairs.candidate_question: Can an employee book a flight 7 days in advance under the travel booking procedure?
pairs.rationale: Booking window changed from 14 days (compliant with advance notice rule) to 7 days (non-compliant; requires expedited approval).

pairs.source_question: Can a purchase order of INR 150,000 be approved with a single qualified vendor quote?
pairs.candidate_question: Can a purchase order of INR 200,000 be approved with a single qualified vendor quote?
pairs.rationale: Procurement amount changed from INR 150,000 (single quote permitted) to INR 200,000 (three competitive bids mandatory).

pairs.source_question: Does taking sick leave for 3 consecutive days require submitting a medical certificate?
pairs.candidate_question: Does taking sick leave for 5 consecutive days require submitting a medical certificate?
pairs.rationale: Consecutive sick leave days changed from 3 (self-certification suffices) to 5 (medical certificate legally mandatory).

pairs.source_question: Can a direct manager approve an expense of INR 50,000 under Travel Policy v2?
pairs.candidate_question: Can a direct manager approve an expense of USD 50,000 under Travel Policy v2?
pairs.rationale: Currency unit changed from domestic INR to foreign USD; foreign currency cannot be evaluated against INR limits.

pairs.source_question: What internal mobility criteria apply when applying for a department transfer?
pairs.candidate_question: What internal mobility criteria apply when applying for a department transfer?
pairs.rationale: Requesting role changed from regular employee to HR specialist; internal mobility transfer processing authorizations differ.

pairs.source_question: How many paid annual vacation days do personnel accrue per year?
pairs.candidate_question: How many paid annual vacation days do personnel accrue per year?
pairs.rationale: Role changed from employee to auditor; audit role context governs compliance inspection rather than personal leave accrual.

pairs.source_question: What is the maximum annual educational assistance grant under standard manager approval?
pairs.candidate_question: What is the maximum annual educational assistance grant under standard manager approval?
pairs.rationale: Role changed from employee to finance specialist; financial disbursement review permissions differ from applicant context.

pairs.source_question: Who is eligible to be issued an Asterline corporate credit card?
pairs.candidate_question: Who is eligible to be issued an Asterline corporate credit card?
pairs.rationale: Role changed from manager to regular employee; corporate credit cards eligibility differs across employee role levels.

pairs.source_question: What approval authority can authorize extraordinary travel exception expenses exceeding INR 100,000?
pairs.candidate_question: What approval authority can authorize extraordinary travel exception expenses exceeding INR 100,000?
pairs.rationale: Role changed from manager to auditor; executive travel exception approvals and audit oversight paths differ.

pairs.source_question: What encryption standards and access controls are mandatory for Restricted classification tier assets?
pairs.candidate_question: What encryption standards and access controls are mandatory for Restricted classification tier assets?
pairs.rationale: Role changed from security personnel to general employee; restricted data encryption procedures must not cross role boundaries.

pairs.source_question: What is the maximum reimbursable nightly hotel rate for metropolitan cities?
pairs.candidate_question: What is the maximum reimbursable nightly hotel rate for metropolitan cities?
pairs.rationale: Effective date crossed the July 1, 2026 policy supersession boundary from Travel Policy v1 (INR 6,000) to v2 (INR 7,500).

pairs.source_question: What is the maximum travel expense amount a reporting manager can approve on their own authority?
pairs.candidate_question: What is the maximum travel expense amount a reporting manager can approve on their own authority?
pairs.rationale: Historical query date active under v1 (INR 40,000 limit) cannot be reused for candidate evaluated under v2 (INR 50,000 limit).

pairs.source_question: Under Travel Policy v1, what lodging reimbursement cap applies to metropolitan locations?
pairs.candidate_question: Under Travel Policy v2, what lodging reimbursement cap applies to metropolitan locations?
pairs.rationale: Source explicitly targets Travel Policy v1 (INR 6,000) whereas candidate explicitly targets Travel Policy v2 (INR 7,500).

pairs.source_question: What daily subsistence meal allowance is provided for domestic travel assignments on March 15, 2026?
pairs.candidate_question: What daily subsistence meal allowance is provided for domestic travel assignments on November 20, 2026?
pairs.rationale: Query date changed across major policy version boundaries; historical version answers cannot be served for current queries.

pairs.source_question: Can an employee book a flight 14 days in advance through the travel portal?
pairs.candidate_question: Can an employee NOT book a flight 14 days in advance through the travel portal?
pairs.rationale: Negation indicator reversed from affirmative booking inquiry to negative prohibition check.

pairs.source_question: Do incidental business expenses up to INR 1,000 require an itemized tax receipt?
pairs.candidate_question: Do incidental business expenses without an itemized tax receipt require manager approval?
pairs.rationale: Introduces negative qualification 'without an itemized tax receipt', altering the documentation inquiry.

pairs.source_question: Can a reporting manager approve an expense amount up to INR 50,000 under Travel Policy v2?
pairs.candidate_question: Can a reporting manager approve an expense amount exceeding INR 50,000 under Travel Policy v2?
pairs.rationale: Comparison direction inverted from 'up to' (manager approval) to 'exceeding' (director approval required).

pairs.source_question: Is single vendor quoting allowed for purchase orders up to INR 150,000?
pairs.candidate_question: Is single vendor quoting allowed for purchase orders greater than INR 150,000?
pairs.rationale: Comparison changed from 'up to' (single quote) to 'greater than' (three competitive quotes mandatory).

pairs.source_question: What approval authority is required for standard travel expenses up to INR 50,000?
pairs.candidate_question: What approval authority is required for emergency travel exceptions up to INR 100,000?
pairs.rationale: Changes category from standard business travel approval to emergency travel exception (requires VP approval).

pairs.source_question: Can employees spend INR 50,000 on business travel under standard manager approval?
pairs.candidate_question: Can employees spend INR 50,000 on personal travel under standard manager approval?
pairs.rationale: Changes expense eligibility from business travel to personal travel (personal expenses non-reimbursable).

pairs.source_question: What approval is required for travel exception expenses up to INR 100,000?
pairs.candidate_question: What approval is required for urgent customer-site deployments on less than 48 hours notice?
pairs.rationale: Changes from general travel exceptions (VP approval) to urgent deployment exemption under 48 hours notice.

pairs.source_question: What spending ceiling governs purchase orders under single quote procurement rules?
pairs.candidate_question: What spending ceiling governs emergency purchases under Director emergency procurement rules?
pairs.rationale: Changes context from regular single-quote procurement (INR 150,000) to emergency procurement rules (INR 300,000).

pairs.source_question: What is the standard monthly spending limit allocated to corporate credit cardholders?
pairs.candidate_question: What is the maximum annual educational assistance amount granted under tuition assistance?
pairs.rationale: Superficially similar monetary limit inquiries but regarding completely unrelated policies (Corporate Card vs Tuition Assistance).

pairs.source_question: Within how many days of expense incurrence must an employee submit an expense claim?
pairs.candidate_question: Within how many working days of submission must supervising managers inspect and approve expense claims?
pairs.rationale: Both ask about day intervals in finance policy, but one is employee filing deadline (30 days) and the other is manager review SLA (5 days).

pairs.source_question: What encryption standard is mandatory for information assets classified as Restricted?
pairs.candidate_question: What rule governs transferring Confidential or Restricted documents outside authorized networks?
pairs.rationale: Both mention Restricted data, but one targets storage encryption (AES-256) while the other targets remote work transmission rules.

pairs.source_question: What continuous service tenure is required before permanent employees become eligible for tuition assistance?
pairs.candidate_question: What minimum tenure in their current role must employees complete before applying for an internal transfer?
pairs.rationale: Both ask about minimum service tenure, but in separate HR policies (Tuition Assistance eligibility vs Internal Mobility transfer eligibility).
